ARTH 312
Contemporary Art History
Explores art and cultural movements from mid-twentieth
century to present, including abstract expressionism,
pop art, and street art.
Weekly lectures
Tues/Thurs 10–11:30 A.M.
Mandatory visits to local art exhibitions.
Students must write critical essays, contribute to discussions,
and complete a research project.
Prerequisite: ARTH 101
